marble.name: Phrases & Clauses
marble.subject: English
marble.description: Understand and analyse the function of phrases (noun, verb, adjectival, adverbial, prepositional) and clauses (main, subordinate, relative) in general and in specific sentences, including recognising and correcting misplaced and dangling modifiers
marble.prompt: If you reads a sentence like "Walking home from school, the rain soaked her backpack" and something feels grammatically off, can they identify the dangling modifier and explain how to rewrite it correctly?

cluster.summary: Your child is learning the building blocks of writing — how to make complete sentences, use capital letters and punctuation marks correctly, and understand basic word types like nouns and verbs.

representations: Bracketed sentence analysis with function labels
Dangling-modifier test: who is doing the -ing?
authoredAnswer: First: the introductory phrase "Hanging on the wall" attaches to "my sister", suggesting she is hanging on the wall (a dangling/misplaced modifier). Rewrite: "My sister admired the painting hanging on the wall." (or "My sister admired the painting that was hanging on the wall."). Second: preposition phrase "with the violin" modifies girl; relative clause "who sat by the window" modifies girl; main clause "The girl ..

wrongAnswers.revealedBy: Accepts dangling modifiers because the intended meaning is guessable. Evidence basis: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts, Language standards, Grade 7. This is an authored observable reasoning/performan
wrongAnswers.fix: Apply the "who is hanging?" test and draw the literal meaning; then rewrite so the modifier sits next to painting.

wrongAnswers.revealedBy: Mislabels a relative clause as a main clause or cannot locate the main clause around it. Evidence basis: Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts, Language standards, Grade 7. This is an authored observable
wrongAnswers.fix: Cover the relative clause and preposition phrase and read what is left; that is the main clause. Reinsert each part and name its job.
